operational_rule: use the 50/50 mix only when the candidate pool is large relative to the budget; the crossover lies between 1,000 and 3,000 keys for k=20 and between 3,000 and 10,000 for k=50
definition_caveat: the hit here is the true top decile, whereas R37/R48/R49 used the Synergy boolean at a 1.4% base rate, so the effect sizes are not comparable and the threshold may move with the target definition
